title: The New Jerusalem
lead: The prophets promised a rebuilt and glorified Jerusalem: foundations of jewels, gates never shut, the LORD its light, and the name "The LORD is there" (Isaiah 54:11–12; Isaiah 60; Ezekiel 40–48; Tobit 13:16–17). Jewish writings pictured a new house for God (1 Enoch 90:28–29), Paul spoke of "the Jerusalem above" (Galatians 4:26), and Revelation ends with the holy city coming down out of heaven (Revelation 21–22).
